epics.summary: Keep the PR title in sync with the story's current summary

stories.summary: Refresh the PR title in _open_pr's already-exists recovery branch so a rescoped story's squash subject matches its final work
stories.description: Item 7 of the post-LD90 review. OA2-05 was rescoped after round 1, but its PR kept the round-1 title and that became the permanent squash commit subject on master.
stories.agent_instructions:
Preflight: impact run 2026-09-23 on 5abd092 - 0 pre-existing failures (full suite 12813 passed, ruff clean) with a stand-in of exactly this change, including the constraint that pipeline/pr.py must not contain `import logging`.
Tier: on-device (local ~20B).

WHY: the squash-merge subject on master is the PR title read back at merge time. A rescoped story (brief rewritten after round 1) keeps its round-1 title because `_open_pr`'s "already exists" recovery branch returns the URL without refreshing the title. This story refreshes it.

FILES: `pipeline/pr.py` (production, 205 lines). New test file `tests/unit/test_pr_title_sync.py`. No doc change (REFERENCE.md and CHANGELOG do not describe PR titles).

WHAT TO BUILD (one new function, one call site):
1. Add this function directly ABOVE `def _open_pr(` in `pipeline/pr.py`:

def _sync_pr_title(worktree: str, branch: str, title: str) -> None:
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            ["gh", "pr", "edit", branch, "--title", title],
            cwd=worktree, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True,
        )
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, OSError):
        pass

The swallow is deliberate: a failed title refresh must never fail the pipeline tick, and the PR already exists with a usable title.
2. In `_open_pr`, in the `except subprocess.CalledProcessError` recovery branch, change the final two statements from
        proc = subprocess.run(["gh", "pr", "view", ...], ...)
        return proc.stdout.strip()
so that `_sync_pr_title(worktree, branch, title)` is called on its own line immediately BEFORE that final `return proc.stdout.strip()` (after the `gh pr view` run). Use a str_replace anchored on the exact text `        return proc.stdout.strip()\n\n\ndef _merge_pr(` (that text occurs once) to make the edit.

HARD CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT add `import logging` or any logging call to `pipeline/pr.py`. An existing test (`test_resolve_story_branch_helper_contract_in_pipeline_pr_module` in tests/unit/test_pipeline_mcp_server_ticketing.py) asserts the module source contains no `import logging`.
- Keep the docstrings of `_open_pr` and `_merge_pr` unchanged (that same test requires the phrase "Tests mock this function" in both).
- The create path (`gh pr create` succeeds) must NOT call `gh pr edit`.
- Do NOT modify or remove anything else in `pipeline/pr.py`: survivors are `_pr_title`, `_resolve_story_branch`, `_merge_pr`, `_format_review_comment`, `_post_pr_comment` and every import.

TESTS (new file `tests/unit/test_pr_title_sync.py`, mock only `subprocess.run` in `pipeline.pr`, e.g. `unittest.mock.patch("pipeline.pr.subprocess.run", side_effect=fake_run)` where `fake_run(args, **kw)` branches on the leading args and returns `subprocess.CompletedProcess(args, 0, stdout=..., stderr="")`; for the recovery case make the `gh pr create` call raise `subprocess.CalledProcessError(1, args, stderr="a pull request already exists")`). Read `_open_pr` and `_resolve_story_branch` first to see which git calls run before `gh pr create`; the fake must answer each. Cases:
- `_sync_pr_title("wt", "agent/X-1", "X-1: New")` runs exactly `["gh", "pr", "edit", "agent/X-1", "--title", "X-1: New"]` with cwd "wt".
- `_sync_pr_title` returns None and does not raise when the run raises `subprocess.CalledProcessError`.
- `_sync_pr_title` returns None and does not raise when the run raises `OSError`.
- `_open_pr` in the "already exists" case: the returned URL is the `gh pr view` stdout, and a `gh pr edit ... --title` call carrying the current `_pr_title(story_key, story["summary"])` was made.
- `_open_pr` in the "already exists" case still returns the URL when the `gh pr edit` call fails.
- `_open_pr` when `gh pr create` succeeds: returns its stdout and makes NO `gh pr edit` call.
- `_open_pr` when `gh pr create` fails with stderr that does NOT contain "already exists": the CalledProcessError propagates and no `gh pr edit` call is made.

SUCCESS CRITERIA: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_pr_title_sync.py` passes; `grep -n "import logging" pipeline/pr.py` prints nothing; `git diff master -- pipeline/pr.py` shows only the new function and the one added call line.

GENERAL: Branch and commit normally. `.agent_scratchpad.md` is gitignored and must never be committed (run `git rm --cached .agent_scratchpad.md` if it ever shows as tracked). Do not add scratch or helper scripts to the diff. Before calling done run the full suite (`.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q`) and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check .` - both must be clean. Do NOT modify any existing test. If a test you did not write fails and your change is what this brief asks for, stop and report the conflict - never undo the brief's required change to make it pass.
